extracted.intended_audience: King Philip II and the Spanish Royal Council / colonial administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Prescriptive recommendations and observations (1570s) about administration, defence, trade, shipping, and justice in the Spanish settlements of the Philippine islands and nearby Asian coasts, addressed to the monarch and royal officials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointment of a respected administrator for justice
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Majesty must appoint a man to that office who will be respected and esteemed, and who possesses the necessary qualifications both for peace and war.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not make trial, especially in the case of those who are to participate in the administration of justice, of men from the Indias. The success of the venture depends on appointing someone who will be respected and who has both civil and military qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Justice as prerequisite for safety and success
rubrics_metrics.description: Every one asserts that the chief deficiency of that land is justice; and without justice there is no safety.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure an effective administration of justice to secure safety and encourage settlement and trade; lack of justice endangers the venture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual reinforcement and munitions shipments
rubrics_metrics.description: Since I came here, I have never failed in any year to send a ship or ships with reënforcements and munitions; but sea and land and climate have their effect, and the number of men is constantly diminished.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regular yearly dispatches of personnel and munitions are required because attrition reduces forces; plan logistics for continual replenishment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ship deployment strategy (two ~500 toneladas vessels; stagger returns)
rubrics_metrics.description: It would not be wise to have two ships of about five hundred toneladas constructed; and to arrange that one of them should not return the same year it went, in order to have time to collect thoroughly all the articles of barter; but that it should return the following year, and another ship then set forth from here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use paired, larger ships with staggered schedules so one remains to collect and consolidate cargo and people, avoiding reliance on many small, inefficient vessels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid reliance on small, shallow, improvised vessels
rubrics_metrics.description: Usually they are miserable little vessels, which draw but little water, and cost almost as much in employing them as a ship of six hundred toneladas--necessitating, as they do, pilot, master, mate, and sailors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Small craft are costly relative to capacity and still require full crews and watches; invest in properly sized, purpose-built ships for economical and safe operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use galleys and light-draught oared vessels for local navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: It would therefore be necessary to build there galleys and light-draught oared vessels, in order to go to those regions that I mention above, and to carry cargoes which the heavy vessels would have to carry to this Nueva España.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because large and deep vessels cannot safely pass among many islands and shoals, maintain a fleet of light-draught vessels for local cruising and cargo transfer to deep-water ships anchored in a secure harbor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop ports and a good harbor
rubrics_metrics.description: It will be necessary to have towns and ports here... It is also necessary to make a good harbor there, in order that ships from outside may find anchorage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish permanent towns, ports, and a safe harbor to support trade, ship repair, and strategic operations; harbors are essential given island shoals and tides.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct commerce with China using silver
rubrics_metrics.description: Thus, to make a long matter short, the commerce with that land must be carried on with silver, which they value above all other things; and I am uncertain whether your Majesty will consent to this on account of having to send it to a foreign kingdom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan trade financing around silver as the principal medium for exchanges with China; weigh the diplomatic/economic implications of sending crown silver abroad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess soldier quality and numbers before mainland operations
rubrics_metrics.description: More and better soldiers would be needful than those who could go from this land, for those born here are but little used to hardship--although it is also understood that the people of China, in spite of possessing weapons, horses, and artillery, are but little superior in valor to the Indians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not underestimate manpower requirements or the need for hardened troops for mainland operations; local-born recruits may lack the endurance required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconnoiter the Chinese coast cautiously and with preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: I had given orders that, when any ship should come from the islands, it should reconnoiter the coast of China on the way... General Miguel Lopez had ordered that it should be adhered to; but when he died, it appeared to Guido de Labezarii to be a dangerous enterprise... Still we shall postpone the carrying out of this until your Majesty shall arrange matters concerning that land; and the person who manages affairs there will make all suitable provision, since he will have more information upon the subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reconnaissance of unfamiliar coasts is valuable but risky; issue clear orders, ensure experienced commanders and up-to-date intelligence before undertaking it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide artillery for emergencies and royal settlements
rubrics_metrics.description: As I have already written your Majesty, there is a lack of artillery here, for those islands take it all--so that I have no artillery for a ship which I am now despatching... In future, will your Majesty kindly order some to be sent both for an emergency like this, and for these royal settlements?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stock colonial outposts and ships with artillery reserves sufficient for emergencies and defense; do not rely on local capture or ad hoc redistribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Send high-quality rigging and canvas, selected by officials or from Bilbao
rubrics_metrics.description: I beg your Majesty, therefore, to send from yonder a large quantity of rigging, both small and cable size, for ships of small tonnage and for larger vessels... Please have sent also a lot of canvas. Your Majesty will have to order the officials to make selection of both, and to see that it is very good; or else let them send to Vilbao [Bilbao] where they say the best rigging is made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure rigging and canvas quality by sending them from reliable sources or ordering officials to inspect selections; poor-quality rigging is costly and risky.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluate market viability of imported commodities (example: cinnamon)
rubrics_metrics.description: I do not believe that the cinnamon will prove a success in this land, for it is very little used... I beg your Majesty to order what disposition is to be made of the same; and likewise to be pleased to advise me whether cinnamon imported by individuals shall be allowed to be brought here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before approving imports or private import privileges, assess local demand and substitute goods; issue clear policy on private imports to avoid market confusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decide legal/status policy for resident foreigners (Portuguese married to natives)
rubrics_metrics.description: Your Majesty orders that no Portuguese shall go to the islands; yet it is understood that some have gone there, and have married Indian women. Will your Majesty please order whether they shall, on this account, be allowed to remain; or whether they, together with the Indian women, shall be sent away?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish and enforce clear residency and marriage policies for foreign nationals in colonies to avoid ambiguous local situations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annex productive repartimientos to the crown for provisioning
rubrics_metrics.description: My opinion is that it would be well to annex it to the royal crown, in order to supply soldiers and sailors with provisions from it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider bringing key productive estates under crown control to ensure steady provisioning for military and naval needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audiencia procedures require formal, signed authority when interacting with Inquisition
rubrics_metrics.description: As for the procedure which this royal Audiencia is to adopt with the Inquisition, there is only a mere document which bears no signature; a copy of which I send which relates thereto. Neither the auditors nor alcaldes are satisfied with this, and they think that they should possess more authority than an unsigned paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Issue signed, authoritative instructions when delegating powers or defining interaction protocols between royal courts and ecclesiastical tribunals to avoid disputes over legitimacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create incentives for merchants by eliminating unjust conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: In the absence of unjust conditions, self-interest will attract people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To spur commerce and settlement, remove arbitrary or unjust practices; fair governance and predictable rules attract merchants and settlers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain adequate crew complements and watches on ships
rubrics_metrics.description: Nor is it possible to get along with less, especially for the different watches, for otherwise the vessels could not possibly be navigated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not reduce required crew (pilot, master, mate, sailors); watches and navigation safety depend on adequate personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploit local mines by employing Spanish operation
rubrics_metrics.description: These are very rich mines from which, it is said, much gold is extracted... In other parts there are more mines, which will yield a great deal of gold throughout, if Spaniards operate and work them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Native-mined deposits may be underworked; consider organizing Spanish-led exploitation to realize mineral wealth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classify and value local gold types for trade and assay
rubrics_metrics.description: The kinds of gold that are found among the natives... Bizlin, which is worth two pesos a tael... Malubay... Linguinguin... Linguinguin gold is worth four pesos... orejera [earring] ... five pesos... guinuguran ... equal to the wrought gold of Spanish jewelry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the local nomenclature and established exchange values to appraise and trade native gold; recognize which types natives use for barter vs. reserve for ceremonies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Survey and catalogue available trade goods and local supplies
rubrics_metrics.description: They have an abundance of silks, and linen likewise... Cloths, on account of the heat prevalent in the country, they neither use nor value. Sugar exists in great abundance. Wax, drugs, and cotton are super-abundant in the islands, whither the Chinese go to obtain them by barter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When planning trade and imports, inventory local production and the preferences of trading partners (e.g., Chinese demand), to avoid shipping unmarketable goods and to focus on goods in demand.
